caption: The drawing depicts an old-fashioned bicycle with two large, spoked wheels colored in shades of orange and brown. The front wheel is significantly larger than the rear wheel. Both wheels have numerous thin spokes radiating from the central hub to the outer rim. The frame of the bicycle is slim and curved, colored mostly in brown and outlined in black, with metal gray components at the fork, handlebars, pedals, and supports. The seat is positioned above the frame and appears gray with black shading. The handlebars are also gray and curve outward and upward at both ends. The pedals are attached directly to the front axle. The background is plain and off-white with no additional objects or details visible. There is a handwritten signature “JOHN L CUTTING” in the bottom right corner.
title: Bicycle
